messages:
Riley: Okay team, urgent debate: if our office LLM could only be one roll of toilet paper, what personality would it have? :roll_eyes:
brototype-bot: Suggestion generated: 'Charmin-v2' Traits: empathetic, repetitively polite, will rephrase your questions 3x before answering.
Jamie: I nominate 'Verbose-Quilt' Behavior: outputs 4 paragraphs for a yes/no question.
Kai: mine is 'Minimal-Token' Behavior: one-word answers, extremely confident, occasionally wrong.
Fern: real question: would you trust a Minimal-Token roll to debug prod? :sweat_smile:
Logan: only if it had a pinned note: "I AM A ROLLER, NOT A REPLACEMENT FOR A RUNBOOK"
Riley: poll: which roll do you want to be our mascotted LLM for Open House?
Riley: :thought_balloon: Charmin-v2 (patient explainer)
Riley: :sparkles: Verbose-Quilt (dramatic help)
Riley: :zap: Minimal-Token (fast & snappy)
Jamie: also can we ship stickers that say 'I survived the Minimal-Token FAQ'
brototype-bot: Fun fact: anthropomorphizing inanimate office supplies increases team bonding by 4.2% (unofficial).
Fern: action: added 'LLM-roll-mascot' to swag wishlist. Also appointing Kai as interim mascot wrangler.
Logan: pipette-bot chimed in: "Will accept bribes in coffee beans." :coffee:
pipette-bot: reminder: please don't feed LLMs actual toilet paper. They do not need the fiber.
Riley: closing: results will be announced at Friday demo (and yes, stickers will be ordered if Charmin-v2 loses)
